func Win32.GET_X_LPARAM #src

The coordinates packed in lParam are signed 16-bit values: they can be negative on multi-monitor setups or when a maximized window is positioned outside the work area. Sign-extend the low/high word manually so the sign is preserved (a narrowing cast would trip the overflow safety check for values above 0x7FFF).
